verdict.rationale: Docs describe a single search call that returns relevant memories, document chunks, and user-profile facts together (searchMode hybrid, 'retrieve three ways: document search, memory graph traversal, and user profile'), and profiles are described as 'always ready' without needing search — this supports assembling a relevant context set in one call. However, there is no explicit documentation of a token-budget parameter or a guaranteed prompt-ready formatted block (e.g. size/limit controls, truncation strategy) for LLM context windows. Missing for 10: explicit token-budget/limit control in the API response, evidence of a formatted prompt-ready context string, and independent confirmation of this exact workflow.
